snapshot.text: Single-payer Mandatory Health Insurance Fund with a state-guaranteed package, but low pay drives doctors abroad. The government is doubling doctors' salaries, building 42 health facilities and testing a new model for state hospitals.

priorities.title: Doctors' pay and housing
priorities.text: Doctors are to receive double salaries and subsidised housing.

priorities.title: Oncology and lower mortality
priorities.text: The ministry's 2026 priorities focus on cancer care and reducing mortality.

priorities.title: New model for state hospitals
priorities.text: A new way of running state hospitals is being tested until the end of 2026.
